description: Pre-flight astronaut resting vital sign reference ranges used as normal baseline before spaceflight mission departure.

resting_heart_rate_bpm.notes: Compare each astronaut's in-flight heart rate against their personal pre-flight resting baseline.

respiratory_rate_breaths_per_min.normal_range: 12 to 18 breaths/min (broad clinical reference up to 20 breaths/min)
respiratory_rate_breaths_per_min.notes: Measured at rest alongside core temperature during pre-flight clinical evaluation.

blood_pressure_mmhg.notes: Documented across recumbent, sitting, and standing postures pre-flight for orthostatic comparison.

sources.citation: NASA Space Flight Human-System Standard & Astronaut Medical Standards Selection / Annual Recertification
